'''Gigagnash''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Wheekroller]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The ultimate solution to feeling insecure is to become the strongest being in existence. Giganash has done exactly so, piloting a nice sturdy mech to bravely crush [[Zobos]] in the way. The world isn't so scary after all."

Gigagnash is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Gigagnash and its evolutions were added to the game on 8/12/2026 alongside [[Technocan]] and [[Blastniff]].
